synopsis: Foretellix Foretify is a commercial tool for coverage-driven scenario generation, constrained random variation and large-scale validation management [f8620, f16019]. It supports an OpenSCENARIO DSL and integrations with external simulators, but is not itself a machine or soil physics engine [f8622, f8627]. A 2021 partnership with Volvo Autonomous Solutions adapted Foretify for mines and quarries, providing independent evidence of off-road applicability [f16020, f9184]. An integration with NVIDIA DRIVE was announced [f8624]. The corpus found neither a public price nor a version date or latest release, leaving cost and release currency unresolved [f8628, f9186, f8629, f9187].
